is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3, 5, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr-east (L1014S), kdr-west (L1014F), and ace-1R (G119S) (page 7, 10, 11, 12, 13).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 3a, 3b, and 4 provide genotype counts (SS, SR, RR) and allelic frequencies for kdr and ace-1 mutations across multiple sites (pages 11, 12, 13).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted on field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. from 22 sentinel districts in Tanzania (page 3, 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting new field data collected in 2023 (page 3, 5).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is reported by sentinel district (e.g., Bariadi, Bukombe, etc.) (page 9, 11, 12, 13).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between May and July 2023 (page 3, 5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new country-wide monitoring study for 2023.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across 22 sentinel districts in Tanzania in 2023. It assessed phenotypic resistance to pyrethroids and pirimiphos-methyl, the impact of PBO on pyrethroid susceptibility, and the frequency of kdr (L1014F/S) and ace-1 (G119S) mutations.
